# Python requirements of CSTTS-DPO (python 3.10). Derived from the requirements.txt of the CosyVoice
# snapshot used in the paper (TTS_finetune/CosyVoice), with the versions of the authors' working
# environment (env/freeze/cosyvoicenew.txt) where the snapshot differs, plus the packages this
# repository adds.
#
# Install into the conda env created from env/environment.yml (it provides pynini==2.1.5 from
# conda-forge, a build dependency of WeTextProcessing that pip cannot compile easily):
#   conda env create -f env/environment.yml && conda activate cstts
# or, into an existing python 3.10 env:  conda install -c conda-forge pynini==2.1.5 && pip install -r env/requirements.txt
--extra-index-url https://download.pytorch.org/whl/cu121

# --- CosyVoice2 core (pins of the CosyVoice snapshot, except onnxruntime: the snapshot leaves it unpinned
# behind an extra onnxruntime-cuda-12 index; 1.21.1 is the working env's version and ships CUDA-12 wheels on PyPI) ---
torch==2.3.1
torchaudio==2.3.1
transformers==4.40.1
numpy==1.26.4              # torch 2.3.1 / librosa 0.10.2 are not numpy-2 compatible
conformer==0.3.2
diffusers==0.29.0
hydra-core==1.3.2
HyperPyYAML==1.2.2
inflect==7.3.1
librosa==0.10.2
lightning==2.2.4
matplotlib==3.7.5
modelscope==1.15.0         # snapshot_download of iic/CosyVoice2-0.5B
networkx==3.1
omegaconf==2.3.0
onnx==1.16.0
onnxruntime-gpu==1.21.1; sys_platform == 'linux'
onnxruntime==1.21.1; sys_platform == 'darwin' or sys_platform == 'win32'
openai-whisper==20231117   # log-mel front end of the Whisper-LAL / CMIspeech scorer
protobuf==4.25
pydantic==2.7.0
pyworld==0.3.4
rich==13.7.1
soundfile==0.12.1
tensorboard==2.14.0
WeTextProcessing==1.0.3    # needs pynini==2.1.5 (conda-forge), see env/environment.yml

# --- added by this repository ---
jiwer==4.0.0                        # optional cross-check of the MER critic (--jiwer_check)
opencc-python-reimplemented==0.1.7  # traditional -> simplified normalisation in the MER scorer
langdetect==1.0.9                   # used by the vendored Whisper-LAL training code (lal/)

# --- NOT needed for inference / training with this repository (CosyVoice's web demo, gRPC/FastAPI
# servers, TensorRT export, DeepSpeed training and download helpers). Install them only if you use
# those parts of CosyVoice itself:
#   gradio fastapi==0.115.6 fastapi-cli==0.0.4 uvicorn==0.30.0 grpcio==1.57.0 grpcio-tools==1.57.0
#   tensorrt-cu12 tensorrt-cu12-bindings tensorrt-cu12-libs deepspeed==0.14.2 gdown==5.1.0 wget==3.2
